Pricing

Simple pricing, clearly laid out.

Three things make up the cost of a website with us — the build, the hosting, and (if you want it) ongoing care. Here is exactly how each one works, with nothing hidden.

1

Choose your website

A one-off build cost. Pick the package that fits — Starter, Professional, or a custom quote.

2

Add hostingRequired

Every website we build is hosted with us at $399/year (incl. GST). It keeps your site fast, secure and online, and covers your domain, SSL and enquiry email.

3

Add a Care PlanOptional

Want us to maintain and update the site for you? Choose a plan — or skip it and manage it yourself. You are never locked in.

Every price is a fixed, no-surprises quote confirmed before we start.

Before you buy

Clear, fair terms.

So you know exactly how it works from purchase to go-live. Buying any package means you agree to these terms.

Your onboarding form starts the work

Before any design or brief begins, we need your onboarding form completed. It captures your details, brand, content and goals so nothing is missed. We do not start design until it is in.

One round of design changes

Your package includes a single round of changes or suggestions on your design mock-up. It is your opportunity to refine the design to the agreed brief before it is finalised.

One review before you go live

After your design is delivered you get one review with minor adjustments. Once you approve it, your site goes live — so please make sure you are happy at this stage.

Ongoing updates are covered by a Care Plan

Once your website is live, any further updates, edits, new pages or features are handled under a Care/maintenance plan — keeping your site secure, updated and supported.

Non-refundable once design begins

Because every build is custom to your business, payments are non-refundable once design work has started.

Clear, GST-inclusive pricing

All prices include GST. Website builds are a one-off cost; secure hosting is $399/year (domain, SSL, hosting and enquiry email). A Care Plan is optional.

In short: work begins once your onboarding form is complete. Your package includes one round of design changes and one review before go-live. After launch, further updates are handled under a Care Plan. All prices include GST and are non-refundable once design work has commenced.

Platform & hosting

Built fast. Hosted safe.

Your Starter or Professional website is built on the Nifty platform as a lightning-fast site with no database or plugins to slow it down or be hacked. You edit it yourself, anytime, in the Nifty Dashboard Builder.

Lightning fast

Every page is pre-built and served ready to go, with no database to slow it down. Your site loads in a blink.

Global edge hosting

Served from a global edge network spanning hundreds of cities, so your site is just as fast for every visitor, wherever they are.

Secure by design

Free SSL and DDoS protection come standard, and with no database or plugins there is nothing for hackers to exploit.

Invisible spam protection

Your forms are protected by invisible, privacy-friendly spam filtering, so real enquiries get through and bots do not.

Reliable form email

Every enquiry is delivered straight to your inbox through a dedicated transactional email account, included with your hosting.

Smart edge routing

Behind the scenes, smart edge routing powers your live editing, instant previews and reliable lead delivery.
